Class MessageService

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.service.MessageService
public final class MessageService extends Object
Service for sending messages and admin commands to a Meshtastic device.

Stateless utility class that builds protobuf ToRadio packets for:

  • text messages, both channel and direct
  • node information requests (NODEINFO_APP)
  • traceroute requests (TRACEROUTE_APP)
  • admin operations: owner info, channels, and configuration

  • Method Details

    • sendChannelMessage

      public static MeshMessage sendChannelMessage(ProtocolHandler handler, DeviceState state, int channelIndex, String text, int replyId)
      Sends a text message to a channel as broadcast, to=0xFFFFFFFF. Creates a MeshMessage, saves it to the database, adds it to DeviceState, and registers it for ACK tracking.
      Parameters:
      handler - protocol handler used for sending
      state - device state
      channelIndex - channel index; 0 is Primary
      text - message text
      replyId - packetId of the quoted message; 0 means no quote
      Returns:
      created message in SENDING status

    • sendDirectMessage

      public static MeshMessage sendDirectMessage(ProtocolHandler handler, DeviceState state, String peerNodeId, String text, int replyId)
      Sends a direct text message to a specific node. Creates a MeshMessage, saves it to the database, adds it to DeviceState, and registers it for ACK tracking.
      Parameters:
      handler - protocol handler used for sending
      state - device state
      peerNodeId - recipient node_id, for example "!9e755af0"
      text - message text
      replyId - packetId of the quoted message; 0 means no quote
      Returns:
      created message in SENDING status

      public static void requestTraceroute(ProtocolHandler handler, DeviceState state, int targetNodeNum)

    • requestOwnerInfo

      public static void requestOwnerInfo(ProtocolHandler handler, DeviceState state)
      Requests owner info (User) and session_passkey from the connected radio. The response arrives as AdminMessage.get_owner_response through ADMIN_APP.

    • requestSessionPasskey

      public static void requestSessionPasskey(ProtocolHandler handler, DeviceState state)
      Requests only session_passkey from the connected radio.

      Uses get_config_request = SESSIONKEY_CONFIG because some devices/firmware do not answer get_owner_request, but still return the session key correctly with the config response.
